announcements.name: Azure Chaos Studio Workspaces and AKS extension
announcements.summary: Organize resilience tests and bring controlled disruption testing to AKS.
announcements.problem: Teams need repeatable ways to test whether applications recover from realistic failures.
announcements.how: Workspaces organize reusable disruption scenarios. The AKS extension adds controlled pod experiments with fewer permissions.
announcements.benefit: Validate recovery before a real outage exposes the weakness.

features.name: Azure Chaos Studio extension for AKS

announcements.name: Confidential computing expands across Azure
announcements.summary: Protect sensitive data while models and applications process it.
announcements.problem: Organizations need stronger controls for AI data, collaboration and model processing.
announcements.how: Azure adds preview options for confidential multi-GPU computing, smaller trusted environments and multiparty clean rooms.
announcements.benefit: Unlock high-value data collaboration without exposing raw information beyond intended participants.

announcements.name: Azure Cobalt 200 virtual machines
announcements.summary: Arm-based VMs add CPU performance for agent and general-purpose workloads.
announcements.problem: AI agents spend work outside the model on CPUs, temporary workspaces and supporting services.
announcements.how: Cobalt 200 is available with consistent or boost speed modes and two new VM families for memory or storage-heavy work.
announcements.benefit: Up to 50% better CPU performance than Cobalt 100, while giving teams consistent or peak-speed choices.

announcements.name: Agentic operations across Azure
announcements.summary: Bring richer context and governed AI operations into Azure monitoring and response.
announcements.problem: Operations teams need faster investigation, consistent policy and shared context across Azure services.
announcements.how: Azure Monitor health models provide live dependency context. Copilot spaces, custom skills and SRE Agent capabilities extend operational agents.
announcements.benefit: Move from investigating isolated telemetry to governed, human-controlled agent workflows.

features.name: Natural language workload planning in Azure Monitor
Azure Copilot spaces and custom skills
Azure Workload Center for Oracle and SAP

announcements.name: Azure AI infrastructure foundation
announcements.summary: Secure networking, isolation and hybrid AKS for production AI applications.
announcements.problem: Production agents need a foundation that spans models, networking, compute, storage and infrastructure policy.
announcements.how: Microsoft Foundry models and agents can extend to customer AKS clusters. Agent Grid, Agent Sandbox and Flex nodes add control.
announcements.benefit: Keep the Foundry workflow from experimentation to production while preserving Kubernetes flexibility.

features.name: Foundry deployment to customer AKS clusters

announcements.name: Azure Catalyst
announcements.summary: A unified experience for AI-powered discovery, planning, migration and modernization.
announcements.problem: Modernization spans estate discovery, planning, migration and execution across Azure and GitHub.
announcements.how: Azure Catalyst connects estate insights with agent-assisted execution in Azure Copilot and GitHub Copilot.
announcements.benefit: Reduce manual work and carry modernization context across applications, databases, storage and networking.

features.name: Deeper estate, application and cost insights

announcements.name: Windows Server 2028
announcements.summary: A preview foundation for stronger security, storage performance and hybrid AI inference.
announcements.problem: Enterprises need current Windows infrastructure to support secure hybrid AI workloads.
announcements.how: The preview adds hardened security, NVMe options, unified management integrations and enterprise AI runtimes.
announcements.benefit: Run AI closer to critical applications and data while extending existing Windows investments.

features.name: Hardened Server Core and security baseline
NVMe over Fabrics and native NVMe storage
Hybrid AI runtimes and Agent 365 integration

announcements.name: Azure Cosmos DB lifecycle updates
announcements.summary: Improve retrieval, application design and backup protection in Azure Cosmos DB.
announcements.problem: Teams need better search relevance, developer tooling and independent production recovery.
announcements.how: Cosmos DB adds retrieval, VS Code, Rust, backup and modeling capabilities.
announcements.benefit: Improve one application lifecycle from design through search and recovery.

announcements.name: Azure DocumentDB expands hybrid and developer options
announcements.summary: Provision, develop and govern MongoDB-compatible workloads across Azure and local environments.
announcements.problem: Document databases need faster development, hybrid deployment and finer access control.
announcements.how: DocumentDB adds VS Code tooling, near-instant provisioning, Arc and Azure Local options and database-level roles.
announcements.benefit: Give teams more placement and least-privilege choices while preserving MongoDB compatibility.

announcements.name: Azure HorizonDB
announcements.summary: A managed PostgreSQL-compatible database for mission-critical and AI applications.
announcements.problem: Developers need transactional data, enterprise resilience and AI capabilities in one managed service.
announcements.how: HorizonDB combines vector search, AI model management, private networking, encryption and multi-zone resilience.
announcements.benefit: Build intelligent applications on trusted transactional data with familiar PostgreSQL tooling.

announcements.name: Redis 8 and an agent kit
announcements.summary: Unify Redis data types and bring Azure guidance into AI-assisted development.
announcements.problem: Modern applications need cache, memory, search and vector context without separate data patterns.
announcements.how: Redis 8 combines supported data types in one Azure Managed Redis version and adds an agent kit for configuration guidance.
announcements.benefit: Simplify application data capabilities and catch reliability or network concerns earlier.

announcements.name: Azure SQL modernization and local development
announcements.summary: Improve resiliency, resource flexibility, migration and local SQL testing.
announcements.problem: SQL Server and Azure SQL teams need continuity across migration, disaster recovery and local development.
announcements.how: Azure SQL adds zone redundancy, flexible memory, multi-database links and a local SQL Database engine container.
announcements.benefit: Modernize more workloads while testing in a local, subscription-free environment.

announcements.name: Database Hub and database agents
announcements.summary: Discover, monitor and manage databases with AI-assisted SQL and PostgreSQL operations.
announcements.problem: Database teams manage estates across Azure, Fabric, on-premises and other clouds.
announcements.how: Database Hub provides one management view. Preview agents observe engine signals and recommend or carry out approved actions.
announcements.benefit: Reduce operational complexity and keep human approval boundaries and permissions intact.

features.name: Database agent in PostgreSQL VS Code extension

announcements.name: Fabric HorizonDB
announcements.summary: Bring serverless PostgreSQL directly into Microsoft Fabric.
announcements.problem: Apps and agents need short-lived, bursty databases and a managed backend for Fabric apps.
announcements.how: Fabric HorizonDB adds serverless databases, mirroring, translytical queries and reverse ETL across Fabric.
announcements.benefit: Provision quickly, pause when idle and connect operational data with analytics.

announcements.name: PostgreSQL migration and modernization on Azure
announcements.summary: Simplify Oracle and PostgreSQL migration with more scale and protection options.
announcements.problem: Teams need a first-party path from discovery and conversion through managed migration.
announcements.how: Azure combines assessment and conversion in VS Code with preview migration service support, flexible compute and backup.
announcements.benefit: Modernize PostgreSQL workloads with more compute, resilience and backup choices.

features.name: Cobalt 200 for Azure Database for PostgreSQL

announcements.name: Custom data apps in Power BI
announcements.summary: Create purpose-built data apps with natural language in Power BI Desktop.
announcements.problem: Report viewers need to enter, update and act on governed business data without switching tools.
announcements.how: Power BI Pro customers can start with a trusted semantic model and describe an app in natural language.
announcements.benefit: Move from viewing insights to interactive workflows that write back to trusted data.

announcements.name: Rayfin and Fabric apps
announcements.summary: A generally available application backend for developers and agents.
announcements.problem: Building an app quickly still requires databases, authentication, hosting and trusted business context.
announcements.how: Rayfin brings SQL or HorizonDB, semantic models, security, governance and observability to Fabric.
announcements.benefit: Build complete governed applications and make trusted analytics interactive.

features.name: Power BI and Fabric app integration

announcements.name: Continuous improvement in Microsoft Foundry
announcements.summary: Turn production traces and evaluations into tested agent and model improvements.
announcements.problem: Teams need a learning loop that links real failures to evaluated changes without unsafe deployments.
announcements.how: Foundry groups production signals, proposes changes and compares them against team-defined quality, safety, latency and cost evaluations.
announcements.benefit: Improve agents and models against a measured baseline before choosing what to deploy.

announcements.name: Microsoft-Decision-1.1
announcements.summary: A fast decision model for routing, classification and workflow control.
announcements.problem: Software decisions are often hard-coded or sent to larger general-purpose models.
announcements.how: Decision-1.1 chooses among permitted actions, adds calibrated confidence and supports image inputs.
announcements.benefit: Make structured decisions quickly at competitive cost and defer when uncertainty is high.

announcements.name: New coding, image and cyber models
announcements.summary: Match specialized first-party and partner models to coding, creation, decisions and security.
announcements.problem: One model does not fit every agent workload, cost target or security requirement.
announcements.how: Foundry adds coding, image, cyber, decision and routing models along with video and open-model providers.
announcements.benefit: Choose across more than 11,000 models and evaluate, train and deploy in one workflow.

announcements.name: Microsoft Copilot SDK 2.0
announcements.summary: Use a production proven Copilot harness in secure, scalable applications.
announcements.problem: Teams need consistent agent security and runtime behavior inside applications and multi-tenant products.
announcements.how: The SDK wraps a native Rust runtime and the same harness technology used across Microsoft and GitHub.
announcements.benefit: Build on six supported programming languages with a production-oriented harness.

announcements.name: Agent 365 FinOps for AI
announcements.summary: Understand, control and optimize AI investment across services and agents.
announcements.problem: AI spending is moving across teams and leaders need to connect cost with business value.
announcements.how: Cost Management brings centralized spend data and policies. Business Analytics measures outcomes and forecasts scenarios.
announcements.benefit: Turn agent spending from a control problem into a governed investment decision.

announcements.name: Autopilot
announcements.summary: An enterprise-grade, long-running personal productivity agent.
announcements.problem: Complex personal workflows continue across threads and sessions without a persistent delegate.
announcements.how: Autopilot runs in the tenant with its own identity, memory and tools and can be mentioned in Teams.
announcements.benefit: Follow up on threads, recurring work and projects while keeping actions visible and governable.

announcements.name: Copilot Managed Runtime
announcements.summary: A common managed hosting and governance layer for applications built across Copilot experiences.
announcements.problem: Apps need consistent hosting, identity, data and management after creation.
announcements.how: The runtime hosts applications and can use Fabric for an optional database, storage and data API backend.
announcements.benefit: Publish across Microsoft Copilot and compatible tools with one enterprise management path.

announcements.name: Copilot Workspaces
announcements.summary: Turn shared context into shared progress around an ongoing workstream.
announcements.problem: Teams need to catch up on shared documents and unresolved work without reconstructing context.
announcements.how: Workspaces connect team context with Copilot summaries of changes, unresolved questions and next actions.
announcements.benefit: Move people from catching up to directing the work together.

announcements.name: Dynamics 365 CRM and ERP plugins
announcements.summary: Complete sales, finance and operations tasks from Copilot.
announcements.problem: Business users need CRM and ERP context without repeated app switching.
announcements.how: Sales and ERP plugins expose purpose-built skills and context to Copilot Cowork and Excel.
announcements.benefit: Prepare meetings, manage deals and streamline source-to-pay tasks in the work experience.

announcements.name: Copilot Code
announcements.summary: Let people build secure dashboards, trackers and apps with natural language.
announcements.problem: Nontraditional developers need a fast app-building path with tenant and local safeguards.
announcements.how: Copilot Code uses agentic technology and cloud or local sandboxes with publishing through Managed Runtime.
announcements.benefit: Build and share apps with tenant identity and existing Microsoft 365 controls.

features.name: Copilot Code on Windows, web, iOS and Android

announcements.name: Home in the Microsoft Copilot app
announcements.summary: A starting point that unifies Chat, Cowork and Office collaboration.
announcements.problem: Users need to move naturally between quick questions and complex delegated work.
announcements.how: Home uses Auto to recommend effort, route to Cowork and carry context into Office experiences.
announcements.benefit: Keep context, documents and collaboration in one flow.

announcements.name: Dynamics 365 Activate for agentic ERP migration
announcements.summary: Extend CRM migration capabilities to SAP ECC and Dynamics 365 ERP.
announcements.problem: Organizations need to assess customizations, dependencies and migration scope before implementation.
announcements.how: Activate adds discovery, requirements analysis, configuration, data migration and shared project context.
announcements.benefit: Carry context from assessment through migration with implementation teams validating recommendations.

announcements.name: Salesforce across Copilot, Teams and Fabric
announcements.summary: Bring Salesforce context and actions into Microsoft work experiences.
announcements.problem: Sellers need customer context and business actions across Microsoft 365.
announcements.how: Salesforce in Copilot uses authenticated MCP access. Teams adds Sales Cloud. Fabric adds a two-way Zero Copy connection.
announcements.benefit: Keep Salesforce context in Copilot, Teams and analytics without copy-based data movement.

features.name: Salesforce Data 360 and Fabric Zero Copy

announcements.name: Today
announcements.summary: A prioritized morning and throughout-the-day view of work across Microsoft 365.
announcements.problem: People need a clear view of priorities and prepared next steps across mail, calendar and chats.
announcements.how: Today Brief creates a morning refresh. Today Feed builds on it throughout the day.
announcements.benefit: Surface priorities and draft actions for human review and approval.

announcements.name: Microsoft IQ
announcements.summary: A governed enterprise context platform that retains what organizations learn.
announcements.problem: Agents need to reuse business context, skills and improvements instead of starting from scratch.
announcements.how: Microsoft IQ combines enterprise context management with continuous improvement in Foundry.
announcements.benefit: Preserve and grow organizational intelligence across apps and agents.

announcements.name: Enterprise context management
announcements.summary: Connect agents to work, business data, unstructured content and real-world knowledge.
announcements.problem: Each agent needs permission-aware context and reusable expertise.
announcements.how: Work IQ, Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ and Web IQ combine with business plugins, skills, tools and agents.
announcements.benefit: Give agents more relevant context and lower unnecessary token use.

features.name: Work IQ, Fabric IQ, Foundry IQ and Web IQ

announcements.name: Foundry IQ
announcements.summary: Bring keyword, vector, knowledge graph and agentic retrieval to applications.
announcements.problem: Unstructured organizational content is difficult to search and trace across relationships.
announcements.how: Foundry IQ combines semantic ranking with knowledge graphs and iterative retrieval.
announcements.benefit: Ground applications and agents in cited organizational knowledge.

features.name: Foundry IQ resource in new projects

announcements.name: Fabric IQ
announcements.summary: Share trusted business meaning across Copilot, Fabric, Excel and third-party assistants.
announcements.problem: Enterprise data needs consistent measures and operational rules before agents act on it.
announcements.how: Fabric IQ combines OneLake, semantic models and ontologies in a shared intelligence layer.
announcements.benefit: Give people and agents one governed understanding of the business.

features.name: Fabric IQ ontologies in GitHub Copilot

announcements.name: Web IQ
announcements.summary: Bring fresh, real-world web knowledge into agents and applications.
announcements.problem: Model context needs relevant external sources beyond business and unstructured data.
announcements.how: Web IQ combines web, news, images, video, places, weather and commerce content with scopes and Auto modes.
announcements.benefit: Ground external knowledge with source controls and lower retrieval complexity.

features.name: Web IQ Auto and Auto Advanced

announcements.name: Work IQ
announcements.summary: Add organizational context, actions and approval controls to Copilot and agents.
announcements.problem: An agent needs richer work context without losing permission and human-control boundaries.
announcements.how: Work IQ expands retrieval and memory, content actions, event listening and enterprise approval controls.
announcements.benefit: Move from context-aware answers to governed action across work content.

announcements.name: Continuous improvement across Microsoft IQ
announcements.summary: Carry production learning through agent configuration and model training.
announcements.problem: Teams need one measured path from automated optimization to custom model training.
announcements.how: Agent Optimizer and post-training capabilities use success criteria and production signals with human approval.
announcements.benefit: What works becomes reusable context, skills and evaluations for future agents.

features.name: Reuse of successful context and evaluations

announcements.name: Dynamic Agent Risk
announcements.summary: Keep an updating risk view across an agent's identity, actions and environment.
announcements.problem: Security teams need a unified view of agent risk instead of stitching siloed tools.
announcements.how: Agent 365 combines runtime, posture and blast radius signals and partner evidence as agents change.
announcements.benefit: Use low, medium or high risk to govern and mitigate agents over time.

announcements.name: Agent 365 management insights
announcements.summary: Expand usage and activity visibility across Microsoft agents.
announcements.problem: Administrators need foundational agent inventory and usage data before adding governance.
announcements.how: Microsoft agents receive management center and Viva Insights metrics regardless of Agent 365 licensing.
announcements.benefit: Understand users, sessions, exception rate and runtime across an agent estate.

announcements.name: Agent 365 governance expansion
announcements.summary: Surface inactive agents, classify work and govern plugins, skills and MCP tools.
announcements.problem: Agent estates need lifecycle cleanup and centralized control over tools and models.
announcements.how: The action center, Agent Map and Microsoft 365 admin controls bring attention and governance tasks into one place.
announcements.benefit: Identify owners, consolidate agents and control tool availability with existing permissions.

announcements.name: Agent 365 business value capabilities
announcements.summary: Connect AI spend and outcomes across Microsoft and third-party agents.
announcements.problem: IT, business and security leaders need a shared view of cost, outcomes and efficiency.
announcements.how: Business Analytics expands reporting and adds recommendations for Microsoft and third-party agents.
announcements.benefit: Maximize value and efficiency with shared financial and outcome context.

announcements.name: Codename MDASH
announcements.summary: An agentic code security system that validates and reduces vulnerability findings.
announcements.problem: Security teams need fewer false positives and evidence for large repository findings.
announcements.how: More than 100 specialized agents map attack surfaces, debate findings, remove duplicates and reproduce where possible.
announcements.benefit: Spend less time triaging low-quality findings and more time acting on validated evidence.

announcements.name: Integrated Security Operations Center
announcements.summary: Unify SIEM and threat protection for people and agents.
announcements.problem: SOC tools need a shared foundation to investigate and respond across the cyber stack.
announcements.how: Core ISOC capabilities combine SIEM and threat protection and add vulnerability shielding.
announcements.benefit: Shield known vulnerable systems while teams apply permanent fixes.

features.name: SIEM breadth and Defender data retention

announcements.name: Runtime protection for local AI agents
announcements.summary: Detect malicious instructions and protect network access for local agents on Windows.
announcements.problem: Local agents process files and tools while attackers hide instructions in content.
announcements.how: Defender scans agent calls. Network DLP, Entra and Purview extend data and access controls.
announcements.benefit: Detect, audit or block risky agent activity with Defender or Intune policies.

announcements.name: Zero-day and emerging threat intelligence
announcements.summary: Surface urgent threats and test available protections from one experience.
announcements.problem: Threat information is scattered and increasingly urgent as attack speed increases.
announcements.how: Defender adds tags, widgets, latest-threat views, email updates and Perception protection playbooks.
announcements.benefit: Find, filter and act on the threats most relevant to an organization.

announcements.name: On-premises security initiative
announcements.summary: Reduce risk across supported Exchange, SharePoint and Skype for Business Server workloads.
announcements.problem: Eligible workloads should move to Microsoft 365, while critical systems still need stronger on-premises protection.
announcements.how: Microsoft combines guidance, migration support and baseline security mode for supported server workloads.
announcements.benefit: Improve updates, safer configuration and temporary protection while permanent fixes are prepared.

announcements.name: Microsoft Entra agentic identity and access
announcements.summary: Discover agents and govern identity, conditional access and network policy at scale.
announcements.problem: Agents need identities and least-privilege controls across local and cloud environments.
announcements.how: Entra Agent ID, MCP access, Conditional Access planning and Global Secure Access apply identity-aware controls.
announcements.benefit: Separate agent activity from humans and control local, cloud and MCP resource access.

features.name: Agent ID for discovered local agents
Agent ID for Microsoft cloud agents

announcements.name: Microsoft Perception
announcements.summary: Specialized agents and playbooks for red, blue and green security work.
announcements.problem: Security teams need coordinated investigation and posture work across the organization.
announcements.how: Red, blue and green agents perform specialized tasks while playbooks orchestrate broader workflows.
announcements.benefit: Triage alerts, investigate attacks and reduce critical exposure with governed automation.

features.name: Triage, investigation and detection authoring agents

announcements.name: Microsoft Purview data security for Copilot and agents
announcements.summary: Classify and protect sensitive data across Copilot, prompts and endpoint agents.
announcements.problem: Sensitive information can flow through Copilot and agent tools without proper context.
announcements.how: Purview adds classification, Copilot DLP, prompt and attachment protection and endpoint agent controls.
announcements.benefit: Accelerate Copilot adoption while blocking unsafe references and agent data exposure.

announcements.name: AI Readiness Initiatives
announcements.summary: Track structured security foundations and exposure reduction with live tenant data.
announcements.problem: Security teams need evidence that identity, endpoints, agents and data gaps are closing.
announcements.how: Perception initiatives measure patching, authentication and agent governance progress with agents and human control.
announcements.benefit: Coordinate work across security domains and verify that exposure is reduced.

announcements.name: Intune local AI agent governance
announcements.summary: Discover local agents and apply compliance, identity and network boundaries.
announcements.problem: Managed devices can run unapproved agents with access to company data.
announcements.how: Intune discovers agents, marks devices noncompliant and uses containers and Global Secure Access for boundaries.
announcements.benefit: Adopt AI agents while keeping endpoint, network and data controls visible.

announcements.name: Edge for Business governed AI and security
announcements.summary: Turn workflows into reusable Copilot skills and govern agent browsing.
announcements.problem: Browser agents and extensions need enterprise identity, permissions and security context.
announcements.how: Edge adds skills recorder, dedicated managed agent windows, extension risk controls and Sentinel or Entra integrations.
announcements.benefit: Let users and agents work faster with predictable steps and organization-wide safeguards.

announcements.name: Copilot on Windows
announcements.summary: Use on-device context for file management, PC diagnostics and Windows Search.
announcements.problem: People need natural-language help for local files and troubleshooting.
announcements.how: Copilot reads Windows diagnostic context and helps find, organize or move files and diagnose issues.
announcements.benefit: Get clearer explanations and supported next steps from the Windows experience.

announcements.name: Windows 365 Cloud PC enhancements
announcements.summary: Improve connectivity, administration and redirection controls for Cloud PCs.
announcements.problem: Organizations need resilient Cloud PC sessions and simpler troubleshooting at scale.
announcements.how: Windows 365 adds Direct Stream enhancements, Intune admin assistant, MAM and context-based redirections.
announcements.benefit: Improve multimedia experiences and manage trust-aware redirections.

announcements.name: Windows and Intune management capabilities
announcements.summary: Move AI into daily work with stronger device security and automatic management.
announcements.problem: Teams need Windows and Intune controls that cover devices, servers and new experiences.
announcements.how: Windows baseline protection, Endpoint Security Platform and declarative management extend baseline controls.
announcements.benefit: Keep devices and applications protected while IT evaluates and introduces experiences.

announcements.name: Windows 365 for Agents
announcements.summary: Run enterprise-ready agents in governed Cloud PCs at scale.
announcements.problem: Computer-using agents need reliable workspaces and access to legacy applications without APIs.
announcements.how: Windows 365 for Agents integrates Copilot Studio and Foundry and introduces persistent Cloud PCs.
announcements.benefit: Unify AI billing and governance across personal and business-process agents.

announcements.name: Windows local and hybrid AI capabilities
announcements.summary: Place models across PCs, Cloud PCs and server-managed environments.
announcements.problem: AI workloads need different execution paths for cost, performance and governance.
announcements.how: Windows supports Foundry Local on Cloud PCs and private multi-user server development environments.
announcements.benefit: Choose a local or managed environment for compatible AI workloads.

announcements.name: Windows process containers for AI agents
announcements.summary: Add protected workspaces, network policy and identity proofing for running agents.
announcements.problem: Agents can reach the wrong resource, impersonate a service or affect the rest of a device.
announcements.how: Process containers provide COM, IPC and network boundaries with learning and permissive enforcement modes.
announcements.benefit: Observe legitimate behavior before gradually enforcing a protected agent workspace.
